_comment: Armies are troops sent out of a village. `support` armies stay at the destination and fight in its battles until recalled; `reinforce` armies join the battle there and go home after; `harass` armies (at least `harass.minCavalryShare` cavalry) strike for one round with a bonus, take only `harass.lossFactor` of their losses, and ride home. A reinforcement arriving from a different side than the horde (at least `pincer.minAngle` degrees apart) gets a pincer bonus on its first round: `scale` x its size / the horde's size, at most `maxBonus`. Villages send `reinforce.defaultShare` of their troops to any battle within `reinforce.defaultRange` hexes unless set otherwise.
